prompts.icons:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production inventory icon atlas for an original hand-painted fantasy MMORPG named Elyndra, in the painterly richness and miniature object rendering tradition of Ragnarok Online and Tree of Savior, with original designs. Generate ONE precisely regular square 1024x1024 atlas with exactly 6 columns and 6 rows, equal size cells, no gutters, no text, no labels, no numbers, no UI frames. Each cell has a completely uniform very dark warm brown background #211d1a, with a single colorful richly hand-painted object centered within its own cell and a 12% empty margin. Strong silhouettes legible at 48 pixels; colorful material highlights, chunky illustrated forms, warm brass and amber lighting, deep contact shadows on each object, not flat vector icons, not line drawings. Do not merge cells or add grid lines. Read left-to-right, top-to-bottom, EXACT contents:
row1: copper curved saber; wooden longbow with leafy accents; teal crystal mage staff; green leather adventurer coat; brown leather boots; steel shield with teal crystal.
row2: red health potion round glass bottle; blue mana potion tall glass vial; golden healing elixir ornate bottle; bread and dried fruit wrapped in linen; glowing teal aether crystal cluster; gold coins.
row3: tuft of vivid green moss fibers; tan seed husk; purple luminous spore dust in a little pouch; soft ivory mushroom mycelium clump; orange amber stone fragment; golden insect carapace shell.
row4: silver soft fur tuft; luminous crescent-shaped green moonleaf; slate stone scale; curved ivory claw; reddish woody thorn; rolled dark brown animal hide.
row5: translucent lavender insect wing; gold sparkling powder pouch; shiny blue fish scale; pink translucent fish gill; bundle of long green reeds; sticky golden sap droplet.
row6: dark rootwood log; glowing orange sap core; thick tree bark plate; copper gear joint; rolled parchment quest scroll with red wax seal; leather satchel with brass buckle.
Every object fully isolated within its cell. Texture detail and light should resemble painted game inventory illustrations. The final image is the atlas itself, no surrounding presentation board.
prompts.skills: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE production square 1024x1024 skill icon atlas for original painterly fantasy MMORPG Elyndra. Precisely a 2 by 2 grid of equal square cells, no gutter, no border, no text, no numbers. FOUR vivid richly painted magical combat illustrations, each readable when reduced to 54 pixels. Top-left: sweeping copper sword in a bright fiery golden crescent cleave, dynamic diagonal slash on deep burgundy background. Top-right: steel blades spinning in a turquoise cyclone, white wind arcs and emerald energy on dark navy background. Bottom-left: a massive silver and bronze shield slamming into the ground emitting a bold orange shockwave, angular powerful composition on deep red background. Bottom-right: brilliant violet and teal Aether crystal exploding into a circular magical pulse, bold central energy burst against deep purple. Painterly fantasy game art with thick beautifully painted strokes, high chroma luminous magical highlights, clear silhouettes, strong value separation, handmade illustrated game texture, NOT outline icons, NOT flat vectors. Keep each skill design fully inside its equal square cell with a 10% safe margin. No characters, no logos.
prompts.frame: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE reusable square hand-painted fantasy game window frame texture, 1024x1024, transparent PNG, original Elyndra MMORPG, warm classic illustrated fantasy. A single perfectly front-facing rectangular square window FRAME, outer edges precisely parallel to canvas edges and almost flush to canvas edges. Entire large center is perfectly TRANSPARENT, and outer background is transparent. All painted pixels stay within 70 pixels of the four edges except corner ornaments which may extend 120 pixels inward. Design: dark walnut wood structural rail, hand-painted warm bronze/gold chamfered molding, tiny ivory highlights along beveled inner edges, restrained curving acanthus leaf engravings at each corner, a small aquamarine gem set into the center of the TOP edge only. Sophisticated illustrated RPG panel craft, beautiful tactile shading and subtle worn patina. Four sides connect continuously. Straight side rails must be visually simple and stretchable, suitable for nine-slice CSS border-image with 128px slices. No drop shadow beyond the frame, no ground, no perspective, no paper or fill in the center, no icons, no text or letters, no invented game screens. Painterly craftsmanship inspired by traditional European bookbinding and hand-painted fantasy MMORPG windows. Thin balanced frame, not bulky and not grotesquely ornate. TRANSPARENT center essential.
